name: Big.net.au
summary: Brisbane unlimited dialup ISP ($27/mo, QLD-wide POPs); rebranded/migrated to KeyPoint (keypoint.com.au) c. 2002-03, domain later redirected to Eftel.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of big.net.au 15 May 1998.

Own-brand ISP homepage ran through late 2002; by Feb 2003 replaced by a 'Big.net >> KeyPoint Redirection Page' migrating users to keypoint.com.au (this static redirect page persisted to Apr 2005). From 2006 big.net.au 302-redirected to Eftel (w3.eftel.com).
